notes: Cross-verse split with JER.5.19. Both verses hold a contiguous interrogative expression the ASV renders by one English word: תַּחַת מֶה → *Wherefore* was fused into one unit under rule 30, while אֵי לָזֹאת → *How* was split, leaving לָ and זֹאת `unrepresented`. Rule 30's one-English-word and contiguity conditions are met in both, and rule 30 disclaims the idiomaticity requirement the verse note relied on. Fused here to match JER.5.19; every other unit in the verse is returned unchanged.
